fields.title: Choose a sharding key
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Polka is being sharded. For each key, name a scenario that will become expensive.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: By user — partner dashboard becomes cross-shard. By store — user history from different stores (34% of audience) and almost guaranteed hot shard from large chains. By date — anything viewing a specific user's or store's history, plus the last shard is always hot, all writes go to it. By city — intercity analytics and a hot Moscow shard. Rule: name the main product scenario first, then the key, not the other way around.
